{{Top|leg}}
A '''''kaysa''''' was a sickle that was a melee weapon used by [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. One was used was to amputate [[Delak Krennel]]'s [[Limb/Legends|arm]] when he threatened to destroy a piece of artwork belonging to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] with a [[Force pike/Legends|force pike]].
